AIR FRANCE
THE WORLD'S LARGEST AIRLINE
NCE
DESCRIPTION OF CLASSES
The Economy Class of all airlines will have 34" between rows of reclining seats. Snack-type meals with hot coffee, tea or soft drinks will be served free
of charge. Alcoholic drinks will not be available. Your baggage allowance will be 44 pounds per person, and the fare from New York to Paris will be
$272 one way, $489.60 round-trip or 18.8% lower than Tourist class.
The Tourist Class seats will recline farther and rows will be 37.9" apart. Full-course hot meals prepared by French chefs are served; French wines,
liqueurs, and soft drinks are available at nominal cost. You may take along 44 pounds of baggage per person. The Tourist fare from New York to Paris is
$335 one way, $603 round-trip.
The First Class seats are wider, only two abreast, and the rows are farther apart. They recline even more fully. Famous "700-mile" meals-sumptuous
full-course French meals with champagne and liqueurs — are served in flight. Between meals you may order what you wish to drink. Full-length double and
single berths are available at extra cost. Your baggage allowance is 66 pounds per person. The fare New York-Paris is $455 one way, $819 round-trip.
The De Luxe Class is even more spacious, with fabulous fully reclining sky-lounge chairs-cloud-soft, with extending foot rests, and semi-private because
of their strictly limited number. Exquisite meals are served in fight. Between meals you may order what you wish to drink. Your baggage allowance is
66 pounds per person. The fare from New York to Paris is $505 one way, $909 round trip.
The breathtaking and exclusive Golden Parisian is unequalled in luxury. The whole giant Super Starliner is specially designed to accommodate only 32
passengers. Dazzling menus prepared by dextrous French chefs delight even the most sophisticated appetites. Specially selected attendants are instantly at
your service. The decor is designed by France's foremost artists. You float along in spacious sky-lounge "fauteuils' and, if you wish, your own double-bedded
— the ultimate in travel luxury — is available at extra cost. Baggage allowance is 66 pounds per person.
